{"content":"import unittest

from poker import best_hands


class BestHandsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_and_single_hand(self):
        self.assertEqual(best_hands([]), [])
        hand = "4S 5S 7H 8D JC"
        self.assertEqual(best_hands([hand]), [hand])

    def test_category_order(self):
        hands = [
            "AS KD 9H 6C 3D",  # high card
            "2S 2D 5H 7C 9D",  # pair
            "2S 2D 3H 3C 9D",  # two pair
            "2S 2D 2H 7C 9D",  # three of a kind
            "2S 3D 4H 5C 6D",  # straight
            "2H 4H 6H 8H 10H",  # flush
            "2S 2D 2H 3C 3D",  # full house
            "2S 2D 2H 2C 9D",  # four of a kind
            "2H 3H 4H 5H 6H",  # straight flush
        ]
        for index, winner in enumerate(hands):
            with self.subTest(category=index):
                self.assertEqual(best_hands(hands[:index + 1]), [winner])
                self.assertEqual(best_hands(hands[index::-1]), [winner])

    def test_tie_breakers(self):
        # Each pair is ordered from weaker to stronger.
        cases = [
            ("AS KD QH JC 8D", "AH KS QD JH 9C"),
            ("KS KD AH QC JD", "AS AD 2H 3C 4D"),
            ("AS AD KH QC 8D", "AH AC KD QS 9C"),
            ("QS QD JH JC AD", "KS KD 2H 2C 3D"),
            ("KS KD 2H 2C AD", "KH KC 3H 3C 4D"),
            ("KS KD 3H 3C 8D", "KH KC 3S 3D 9C"),
            ("2S 2D 2H AC KD", "3S 3D 3H 4C 5D"),
            ("3S 3D 3H AC 8D", "3C 3D 3H AS 9D"),
            ("2S 3D 4H 5C 6D", "3S 4D 5H 6C 7D"),
            ("AS JS 9S 7S 2S", "AH JH 9H 7H 3H"),
            ("2S 2D 2H AC AD", "3S 3D 3H 4C 4D"),
            ("3S 3D 3H 4C 4D", "3S 3D 3H 5C 5D"),
            ("2S 2D 2H 2C AD", "3S 3D 3H 3C 4D"),
            ("3S 3D 3H 3C 4D", "3S 3D 3H 3C 5D"),
            ("2H 3H 4H 5H 6H", "3S 4S 5S 6S 7S"),
        ]
        for weaker, stronger in cases:
            with self.subTest(weaker=weaker, stronger=stronger):
                self.assertEqual(best_hands([weaker, stronger]), [stronger])

    def test_ace_low_and_ace_high_straights(self):
        wheel = "AS 2D 3H 4C 5D"
        six_high = "2S 3D 4H 5C 6D"
        broadway = "10S JD QH KC AD"
        self.assertEqual(best_hands([wheel, six_high]), [six_high])
        self.assertEqual(best_hands([six_high, broadway]), [broadway])
        self.assertEqual(
            best_hands(["AS 2S 3S 4S 5S", "2H 3H 4H 5H 6H"]),
            ["2H 3H 4H 5H 6H"],
        )

    def test_straights_cannot_wrap_or_repeat_ranks(self):
        pair = "2S 2D 3H 4C 6D"
        wrapped = "QS KD AH 2C 3D"
        self.assertEqual(best_hands([wrapped, pair]), [pair])
        self.assertEqual(
            best_hands([pair, "3S 3D 7H 8C 9D"]), ["3S 3D 7H 8C 9D"]
        )

    def test_ties_keep_original_strings_order_and_duplicates(self):
        first = "4S 5S 7H 8D JC"
        second = "JD 8C 7S 5H 4H"
        hands = [first, "2S 3S 4H 5D 7C", second, first]
        self.assertEqual(best_hands(hands), [first, second, first])
        self.assertEqual(hands, [first, "2S 3S 4H 5D 7C", second, first])

    def test_ten_spellings_and_unordered_cards(self):
        hands = ["AS 10S QS JS KS", "JH AH KH TH QH"]
        self.assertEqual(best_hands(hands), hands)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
